summary: BULKAPI live casino integration tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/16 pytest pass (launch URL w/ 6 params + wallet_inr=promo_balance*rate, failed launch logging, callbacks on both paths: win/loss/exact duplicate/same-round update by difference, 403 invalid token, 400 missing fields, 404 unknown mobile, JSON body, admin status/rate/test/sessions/rounds/players/callbacks filters, games CRUD + staff 403s). One real bug: callback accepts bet_amount='nan' (and likely 'inf') -> player promo_balance becomes NaN and /api/admin/live/players returns 500. Frontend: admin /admin/live-casino all 5 tabs + tables, filters, rate save, test connection (ConnectError expected), callback URLs OK; player /app/live-casino lists games and click navigates to https://bulkapi.org/launch_game with all params (DNS fail expected). Regression pages /app, /app/deposits, /app/statement, /app/games, /admin/deposits load without console errors.

critical.issue: _f() uses float() which accepts 'nan'/'inf'. bet_amount=nan with valid token returns 'ok', $inc NaN into users.promo_balance (balance becomes NaN), inserts NaN transaction/round; afterwards GET /api/admin/live/players 500s with 'ValueError: Out of range float values are not JSON compliant' (and any endpoint serializing that balance/tx will too). Fix: reject non-finite values (math.isfinite) in _f and return 400.

minor.issue: When prev round exists, user is not checked against prev['user_id']; a game_round reused with a different mobile would compute delta against another user's applied_usd and reassign the round. Add check prev.user_id == user.id (else 409/log).
make_tx rounds amount to 2 decimals while promo_balance is $inc'd by 4-decimal delta (e.g. ₹1 at rate 95 = $0.0105 -> tx shows $0.01); ledger won't reconcile exactly with balance over many rounds.
Returns ok even for unknown id (no 404).
Does a live HEAD to bulkapi.org (6s timeout) on every call; admin page calls it twice (StatusCard + RateCard) -> slow page load while DNS is down.

ui_bugs.issue: After saving a new rate in RateCard, the Connection card still shows the old 'INR rate $1 = ₹95' (separate useFetch, not reloaded). Share one fetch or reload both.

action_items: Reject non-finite bet_amount/win_amount (nan/inf) in bulkapi._f -> 400 'Invalid bet_amount'
Verify prev round belongs to same user before applying update delta
Reload StatusCard after rate save (or share data between StatusCard/RateCard)
Optional: 404 on deleting unknown game; cache reachable check in /admin/live/status
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency logic (unique game_round + conditional update on applied_usd + $inc) verified correct for exact duplicates and amount updates
Non-finite float input is the only path found that corrupts balances
Secret key is 30 bytes (status shows 30/32) - user to supply real key; not counted as bug
